Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the effect of zoning ordinances on hobby vehicle restoration.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the effect of zoning ordinances on hobby vehiclerestoration; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 35.63 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35A.63RCW; adding a new section to chapter 36.70 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided under subsection (3) of this section, a cityor town shall not enact, enforce, or maintain an ordinance, developmentregulation, zoning regulation, or official control, policy, oradministrative practice that prohibits hobby vehicle restoration. (2) For the purposes of this section, "hobby vehicle restoration"means the restoration of four or fewer vehicles that are thirty yearsor older of which the person restoring the vehicle has title and isactively working towards restoration of the vehicle. Hobby vehiclerestoration does not prohibit the use of one additional vehicle for thepurposes of parts salvage only. An activity qualifies as hobby vehicle p. 1 SSB 5586restoration when the restoration of the vehicle or vehicles is anancillary use of the property upon which the restoration takes place. (3) This section does not prohibit a city or town from enacting,enforcing, or maintaining an ordinance, development regulation, zoningregulation, or official control, policy, or administrative practice tootherwise regulate hobby vehicle restoration.
